image_description: A close-up, eye-level view of a glass display case inside a bakery. The case features multiple shelves stocked with various baked goods, including golden-brown pastries, buns, and cakes on trays. The lighting is warm and reflects off the glass surfaces. In the background, through the upper part of the window/case, there are hints of the shop interior or exterior street, but the focus is strictly on the merchandise within the case.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the objects are correctly identified as specific types of baked goods (pastries, breads) rather than generic blobs.
To assess the realism of textures, lighting reflections on glass, and overall photographic quality.
To check if the shelves are parallel and structurally sound, and if the glass reflections align with the scene geometry.
To ensure individual pastry items have distinct boundaries and do not fuse into the trays or each other.

Clarity of glass reflections vs. background objects

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'waxy' appearance of the food items. In AI images, baked goods often lose their porous texture and look like plastic. Also, verify if the glass reflections are physically consistent with the light sources, or if they appear painted on.
